data.name: Sourabh
data.gender_notes: Sourabh is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit saurabha, 'fragrance, perfume'. Its root is Sanskrit su + rabh. A classical Sanskrit term for fragrance. Sourabh is a Sanskrit name meaning “Fragrance; perfume; beauty”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Sourabh expresses “Fragrance; perfume; beauty”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sourabh total 30, reducing to 3. Number 3 is associated with expression, creativity and optimism.

vedic_reference.note: The name 'Sourabh' is derived from the Sanskrit word 'शूर' (shūr) which means 'Brave' or 'Courageous'. It is also the name of a king in Indian mythology who was known for his bravery.
